title: Louis XIV to the duc de Chaulnes, Versailles, 10 July 1690 (300-group one-part code)

documents.shelfmark: Private (offered by Traces Écrites, Paris, 2017, ref. 11273)

plaintext.source: Minute presumably in AE Correspondance politique Rome 331-332, not seen; Recueil des instructions Rome II, Gérin 1870/1877/1894 checked and negative.

transcription.source: Dealer/Tomokiyo transcription verified group by group on the five page photographs at 2x
transcription.notes: NOTES give 300 groups, 116 distinct (matching the dealer's '300 chiffres'); the measured 311/133 also counts the [P1]-style passage labels and clear figures such as 1682 in the file.

system.summary: One-part Croissy foreign-office code of at least 535 entries: low numbers for letters, then a ten-column table with each consonant's syllables down a column at steps of 10.

diacritics.note: Nine groups underlined and two small raised figures; function unknown.

system.sibling_key: Sister Croissy codes 1684-1702 (d'Avaux, Béthune, Teil, Castaignère, Harlay, Usson) share the design; the 1690 Castaignère code does not match.
system.notes: Step-10 chains such as 439-449-459-469-479 establish the column design.

prior_solution.where: No printed plaintext found; Klausis Krypto Kolumne 2019 thread unbroken

conditions.human_role: Supplied a Google Books copy of Gérin 1877 (RQH t. XXII) to check.

solution.what: Verified all nine cipher passages against the page images; two corrections (523, 456).
Frequencies, repeats and step-10 chains place the code in the Croissy ten-column design.
Searched Recueil des instructions Rome II, Gérin 1870, 1877, 1894, Google Books phrases, DECODE for a printed plaintext or key.
Built a 300-group matched control with a random code of the same design.
Annealer v1-v4: recovers 4-12% of the control and wrong keys score within noise of the true one; real-letter output is fluent nonsense.
Scored alphabetical letter-block hypotheses on the low-code bursts: none fits.

outcome.method_basis: Ciphertext-only annealing of the 300-group Croissy-type one-part code failed on a matched control and on the letter; no printed plaintext or key was found (Recueil des instructions Rome II, Gerin checked).
outcome.notes: 300 groups do not determine a 116-entry nomenclator; needs the minute in AE Rome Corr. 331-332.
